io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: Tersign is the evidence layer for agent commerce (B2B / machine-to-machine). Agents issue seller-signed EIP-712 receipts and action records; the hosted ledger at https://tersign.ai optionally counter-signs them into per-seller hash chains that anyone can verify without an account. Disputes export as venue-ready evidence envelopes (generic / internet-court / kleros / uma). The SDK and MCP server work fully standalone without the hosted ledger: issue and verify offline, counter-sign later. No configuration is needed: every environment variable is optional, and the server generates and keeps a local signing key on first run when none is set. record_disclosure's first call self-provisions a free signer-keyed account on the ledger (https://tersign.ai by default), except when that key is already registered to an API-key account (409) or the daily provisioning caps are reached (429; https://tersign.ai/pricing). Canonical bytes, digests and chain construction are pinned by public two-sided conformance vectors: https://github.com/tersignhq/evidence-record-conformance (Apache-2.0, CI-tested). Verify a live counter-signed record right now: npx tersign verify 0xe5874f1ffe87f0a6dd9eb157730f67b86ee4538b125fe30fcc4e165213dd3fc4 --ledger https://tersign.ai

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: Pre-spend trust for AI agents that buy things. x402 services: free preflight and merchant_card (wash_flagged refuses), first paid hop GET /v1/intel/quick/{seller_payTo} at 0.001 USDC, optional portable V7 receipts at GET /v1/intel/trust (V5 and V6 still verify). Product listings: the free MCP tool check_listing tests a store product against TWZRD's published listing-claim card (one reference card today) and flags needs_approval when a declared price cannot be backed; get_claim and get_evidence return the card and get_publication returns the Ed25519-signed publication record to verify it offline; get_shopping_check returns the Agent Shopping Check report. Nothing here authorizes spending. TWZRD Bazaar catalog is GET /v1/intel/bazaar/offers — not GET /v1/intel/marketplace (listing overlay, not a bazaar) and not 402 extensions.bazaar.
